tools.name: seo_check
tools.description: On-page SEO check of one public URL: title, meta description, H1, canonical, Open Graph, lang, viewport, noindex, word count and empty JavaScript app shells, robots.txt, XML sitemap, HTTPS, server response time and HTML size. Returns a 0-100 score and a plain-English fix for each issue.

tools.name: ai_visibility_check
tools.description: Checks whether AI crawlers and AI search tools (ChatGPT, Claude, Perplexity, Google AI Overviews, Copilot) can read and cite a public URL: robots.txt rules for GPTBot, OAI-SearchBot, ChatGPT-User, ClaudeBot, Claude-SearchBot, PerplexityBot, Google-Extended, CCBot, Applebot-Extended and Bytespider; t

tools.name: security_headers_check
tools.description: Passive security check of one public URL: one ordinary page load plus public DNS. Grades HTTPS, HSTS, Content-Security-Policy, clickjacking protection, X-Content-Type-Options, Referrer-Policy, Permissions-Policy, version-leaking headers, cookie flags, SPF, DMARC, DKIM, CAA and DNSSEC from A to F, wi

tools.name: full_site_crawl
tools.description: Crawls up to 25 pages of a public site (from its XML sitemap, or homepage links) and checks each for title, meta description, H1, canonical, noindex, html lang, Open Graph, thin content and HTTP errors, plus site-wide duplicate titles and descriptions. Needs Audit Pro ($15 per 3 months): https://aud

tools.name: compare_competitors
tools.description: Side-by-side on-page, AI-crawler and security-header signals for your page and up to 3 competitor pages: response time, title and description length, H1, word count, JSON-LD types, llms.txt, AI crawlers blocked in robots.txt, security headers. No backlink or domain-authority metrics. Needs Audit Pro

tools.name: bulk_check
tools.description: Quick on-page check of up to 10 URLs in one call: HTTP status, title, meta description, H1, canonical, noindex, lang, Open Graph and thin content. Needs Audit Pro ($15 per 3 months): https://audit.huutran.dev/mcp-server#pro

findings.title: Description references secrets/credentials
findings.detail: Description of "security_headers_check" references sensitive artifacts (cookie). A tool description has no reason to mention credentials.
